description: The Statistical Office of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines published its 2023 Population and Housing Census report, whose housing chapter compares 2012 and 2023 and tabulates households by lighting type, water supply and toilet facilities by census division, with maps of public electricity, piped water and flush toilet penetration. The report states that public-grid electricity reached 93 percent of households, piped water into dwellings rose from 71 to 80 percent, septic systems served 86 percent and more than 85 percent of dwellings were of concrete and block, with nearly half built before 1999 and the Grenadines relying more on private catchments. The 2012 census is also online as a REDATAM database whose geography runs from census divisions to enumeration districts, buildings and dwellings, with household variables on walls, roof, year built, insurance, water, toilet, lighting, generators and water pumps. Format and access: free PDF and free online processing. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: 2023 tables sit in a PDF, and only the 2012 microdata can be tabulated online. Simulation uses: census division electricity and water coverage and building age and materials for hurricane and volcanic exposure. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub and the Montserrat 2011 census database.
